rows.name: Kosui
rows.description: This variety is a hybrid of 'Kikusui' x 'Wasekozo' and was released in 1959 by the National Horticultural Research Station, Tsukuba, Japan. The fruit is medium in size, and the surface is yellow-bronze with russet. The flesh is crisp, very sweet, juicy, and has low acid.

rows.name: Hosui
rows.description: This variety is a hybrid of 'Kikusui' x 'Yakumo' and was released in 1972 by the National Horticultural Research Station, Tsukuba, Japan. The fruit is large and round globular in shape. The skin is solid russet and golden with pronounced lenticels. The flesh is off-white sweet, mild, crisp, and juicy. There is a little acid, which gives it a fairly complex flavor. Fruits store about 4 weeks.
